name: domain-hound
description: Check domain availability and prices, and screen product names, from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Domain Hound checks registry availability, compares upfront and renewal prices, and screens product names for trademarks, app store clashes and web traction. It can watch a domain for release. Connect your own Spaceship account to get a live quote and set up website or mail DNS. Payment happens at Spaceship checkout. Domain Hound runs on your machine and is open source under the MIT license.
